content: स्निह् €4 <ab>P.</ab> (स्निह्यति, स्निग्ध) .²1 To feel or have affection for, love, be fond of (with <ab>loc.</ab> of the person or thing that is loved or liked); किं नु खलु बालेऽस्मिन्नौरस इव पुत्रे स्निह्यति मे मनः <ls>Ś. 7</ls>; स च स्निह्यत्यावयोः <ls>U. 6</ls> (where आवयोः may be genitive also). .²2 To be easily attached. .²3 To be pleased with, be kind to. .²4 To be sticky, viscid, or adhesive. .²5 To be smooth or bland. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (स्नेहयति-ते) .²1 To make unctuous, anoint, besmear, lubricate. .²2 To cause to love. .²3 To dissolve, destroy, kill.
